subject: What was the result of the final battle against Sukuna?

beats.title: Usage / Satoru Gojo
beats.text: Both Satoru and Sukuna recovered their exhausted cursed techniques using reverse cursed technique and then expanded their domains at the same time. This fourth clash led to the same result as the third, with both domains collapsing at the same time.(Chapter 229) In the fifth and final clash between Unlimited Void and Malevolent Shrine, Sukuna was just slightly late in opening his domain. The difference was less than 0.01 seconds but it was long enough to immobilize Sukuna for just a moment. This was enough time for Satoru to severely injure Sukuna with a single strike. They fought for two minutes and forty seconds before Malevolent Shrine collapsed as a result of Sukuna's extensive injuries, allowing Unlimited Void to completely incapacitate him. However, before Satoru could capitalize, Sukuna summoned Mahoraga and the shikigami immediately destroyed the domain.(Chapter 229)

beats.title: Synopsis / Shinjuku Showdown Arc
beats.text: Following Sukuna's defeat in his battle against the sorcerers, Uraume and Hakari sensed the conclusion. Uraume remarked that Sukuna's loss was due to his incarnated form and the new generation of sorcerers were merely lucky they were born a thousand years later, with this comment flattering Hakari. As his final act, Uraume used his technique to bisect his neck, ultimately withering away as a result.(Chapter 268)

beats.title: Usage
beats.text: Because of Nobara's interference, a heavily wounded Sukuna was unable to defend against Yuji's domain's sure-hit effect, allowing him to successfully unleash a soul-rending Dismantle, followed by Divergent Fist and finally a Black Flash that brought the battle to an end.(Chapter 267)

beats.title: Usage / Yuta Okkotsu
beats.text: During the final battle against Sukuna, Yuta was able to heal from multiple of the King Of Curses' slashes, even when taken by surprise due to their high-speed.(Chapter 250)

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Earlier, after recovering with the assistance of Shoko Ieiri and Yuta Okkotsu, Hana questioned what would become of Megumi. Although her primary role had been to unseal Satoru Gojo, Yuta requested her aid in their final effort against Sukuna. He clarified that she would not need to participate directly in combat only to deliver the finishing blow with Jacob's Ladder, a last-resort attack intended to separate Sukuna’s and Megumi’s souls.

beats.title: Usage / Yuji Itadori
beats.text: Yuji learned how to use New Shadow Style: Simple Domain in the one month before the final battle against Sukuna by swapping souls with Kusakabe during replacement training.(Chapter 258) He used this anti-domain technique to protect himself from Sukuna's impromptu Malevolent Shrine, which was able to resist the domain expansion for almost 99 seconds before being stripped away.(Chapter 258)

beats.title: Aftermath
beats.text:
Finished with the battle, Sukuna tells Yuji to take his body back. However, there's no response from the boy and Sukuna realizes that Yuji can't revert for the moment, causing Sukuna's face to split in a horrifying grin. Outside, Megumi notices that the domain has disappeared, meaning that the Finger Bearer is dead. He waits for Yuji to return, but Sukuna suddenly reappears in his stead.

Sukuna surprises Megumi and reveals that this must be a side effect of Yuji using Sukuna without restriction. Even so, Sukuna knows its only a matter of time and decides to rip out Yuji's heart, effectively taking him hostage; should Yuji switch back now, he'll die. Now having free rein over his vessel's body, Sukuna decides to have some fun by killing Megumi. The disgruntled student claims that this situation is the reverse of the Sugisawa incident as the battle begins.(Chapter 8, Episode 5)

beats.title: Battle
beats.text: Unharmed, Sukuna appears next to Jogo, sitting on the smoldering meteor. He taunts his opponent by saying that the maximum technique would have hurt... if it hit. He also asks why Jogo why he won't use Domain Expansion. Jogo admits he would lose in a battle of domains and Sukuna knows that this lack of confidence is because of his loss to Satoru Gojo.
